memorial_rites.title: Roll-Call Naming
memorial_rites.description: At the first morning muster after a loss, the deceased's name echoes off the cold concrete. The ensuing three seconds of heavy silence speak louder than any eulogy, forcing the survivors to feel the new emptiness in their ranks.

memorial_rites.title: The Unmade Bunk Night
memorial_rites.description: For twenty-four hours, the deceased's bunk remains a sacred, untouched island in the crowded dormitory. The perfectly folded wool blanket at the footboard serves as a haunting reminder of the body that will never return to warm it.

memorial_rites.title: The Small Tin Division
memorial_rites.description: A somber division of meager spoils. Close peers sift through a pathetic pile of scavenged trinkets—a broken comb, a pencil stub, a bloodstained glove. One piece is kept as a relic; the rest are absorbed back into the shelter's desperate economy.

memorial_rites.title: The Final Shift Detail
memorial_rites.description: Shift companions carry the shrouded body to the ash vault in absolute, suffocating silence. The only sounds are the grating of bone-dry hinges and the rhythmic, desperate tightening of the final bolts, sealing their friend away from the living.

memorial_rites.title: Memorial Wall Inscription
memorial_rites.description: With each brutal strike of the center punch, the survivor's surname and days lived are gouged into the weeping limestone of the lower gallery. It is a desperate, permanent scar on the bunker walls, proving that they were here, and that they fought.

memorial_rites.title: The Spoken Wish Fulfillment
memorial_rites.description: A hollow voice reads the deceased's Final Wish to the assembled, exhausted crowd. It is a crushing moment of vulnerability, binding the survivors to a promise made to a ghost in a world where promises are rarely kept.
